title: Query probability of the first coordinate
statement: For every real parameter $t$, consider the deterministic three-coordinate decision tree on inputs $x\in\{-1,1\}^3$ that first queries coordinate $0$; if $x_0=-1$, it queries coordinate $1$ and, unless $x_1=-1$, then queries coordinate $2$; if $x_0=1$, it queries coordinate $2$ and, unless $x_2=-1$, then queries coordinate $1$. When its seed is sampled trivially and its input is sampled uniformly from the sign cube, the probability that it queries coordinate $0$ is $1$.
